summary: This is an 8-K filing by Reborn Coffee, Inc. regarding an Amended and Restated Forbearance Agreement with Arena Investors. It amends repayment terms for existing 10% Original Issue Discount Secured Convertible Debentures, detailing a schedule of $400,000 monthly payments beginning April 30, 2026, plus 70% of net proceeds from any securities sales, with full payment due by September 30, 2026. The filing relates to debt restructuring and forbearance, not a special situation like acquisition or restructuring. It is a routine disclosure of a material definitive agreement modifying prior financing terms; no event triggers a special-situation category.
